what: MEASURED 2026-09-22 by the E20 lane, after the manager reframed three separate incidents as one MISSING INVARIANT: a check must be able to say when it cannot see its subject, and that must be loud. POPULATION: 95 guard scripts (scripts/ci/check_*.py + scripts/check_*.py), every MODULE-LEVEL repo-path constant tested with `git cat-file -e HEAD:<path>`. RESULT, four states never collapsed: 46 declare no module-level repo path so THE INSTRUMENT CANNOT SPEAK TO THEM (reported as its own count, never folded into `live`); 30 live; 11 DEGRADED (some subjects absent, so they grade a silently narrower set); 8 DEAD (every declared subject absent, so they grade NOTHING and their green means nothing). [!] THE INSTRUMENT WAS VALIDATED BEFORE IT WAS TRUSTED, and the naive version FAILED. Scanning for any path literal anywhere returns 29 of 69 scripts/ci files and is DOMINATED BY SELF-TEST FIXTURES — docs/WORKPLAN-a.md, scripts/ops/bare_tool.py, .github/pr-landing/nested/f.json are planted inside self_test() and a guard is SUPPOSED to plant paths that do not exist. Restricting to ast.Module.body (never a function body) removes that whole class: 19 of 95 with no fixture noise. The self-test carries that as an explicit control (N3), so a future edit that walks into function bodies again fails rather than silently re-inflating. [!] THE 8 DEAD: check_backlog_unresolve, check_claim_basis, check_open_items, check_operator_owed, check_recurrence_ledger, check_register_field_loss, check_soak_registered, check_stated_population. Every one is the 2026-09-21 operating reset's blast radius — it archived the four review backlogs, OPEN-ITEMS.json, the lease, SESSIONS.json, MERGE-QUEUE.json, session-board.json, RECURRENCE-LEDGER.json and operator-owed-register.json, and nothing swept the guards that read them. [!] AND THREE OF THE DEAD ARE NAMED IN docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md AS LIVE MECHANISMS, which is the part that should decide the priority. § Backlog governance says the `status` enum is 'enforced whole-file over every review backlog by claim-basis-guard' — all four backlogs are archived, so check_claim_basis.py grades nothing. § 'A soak must carry its own alarm' says check_soak_registered.py 'fails when a *_soak.jsonl log exists in src/ with no register alarm' — its register (docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json) is archived. § Session-end reconciliation says operator-owed-guard 'FAILS when an item has been carried across register commits without a state change' — its register is archived. A canonical doc naming a mechanism that cannot run is the folklore failure that document has its own section about, and it is the #1 doc in the instruction hierarchy. [!] THE MECHANISM BUILT FOR IT: scripts/ci/check_guard_liveness.py, wired into run_guards.py as `guard-liveness` with when: None (whole-tree, because a diff-scoped version would pass vacuously on nearly every PR). It is REPORT-FIRST ON PURPOSE and that is not weakness: the 19 already-broken guards are carried in a dated BASELINE that may only SHRINK with the count printed on every run, and only a NEW dead/degraded guard FAILS. Failing all 19 on day one would red-wall the repo and get the guard reverted rather than the debt fixed — the reasoning check_pr_queue_watch.py records, and § 'could not measure is its own outcome' records a guard whose first CI run emitted 117 fake findings and buried the only fact that mattered. A baseline entry whose subject came BACK, or whose guard no longer exists, also fails, so the list cannot rot into a permanent hole. Self-test 14 cases, every state planted with its control. [!] WHAT THIS SWEEP DOES NOT REACH, stated rather than implied: an archived INPUT is not the only way a check dies. The third incident (check_manager_queue_watch, armed 479h and never receipted) has a subject that EXISTS as a path — what died is the Routine that writes it, filed separately as PI-20260922-ROUTINE-FIRED-SESSIONS-GET-NO-REPO-AND-NO-MCP-WHICH-IS-THE-ONE-ROOT-CAUSE-BEHIND-BOTH-DEAD-WATCHDOGS. And `live` here means ONLY that a subject exists, never that the guard works. [!] THE DECISION OWED: for each of the 19, re-point or retire. `killed` with a stated reason is a first-class outcome and is probably right for several — a guard reading a register the operator deliberately archived may simply not be wanted. Do not repair reflexively, and do not promote the baseline to blocking without the operator choosing to.
